scope: A9 external private-pack and approval-manifest admission stability
verified_behavior: Private-pack and approval manifests are read as bounded regular files without following final symlinks.
Parsed payload and projected hash use the same stable bytes.
Preflight rechecks the private manifest before returning a fingerprint.
Approval check rechecks both authority files before returning a valid receipt.
Real benchmark rechecks both authority files immediately before dispatch and after runner completion.
Approval, private manifest, runner or environment drift fails before a valid receipt; pre-dispatch drift invokes no runner.

pending_manifest_probe.reason: private pack manifest fails schema validation

open_human_gates: Owner review of all six execution/golden record pairs
Exact human approval validity window and bounded limits
Independent request-boundary/non-transfer receipt after an approved run
Human review and seal of the first approved baseline
